items.prompt: A road trip is 120 km. Dina drove three eighths of it before lunch. Build a part-whole model with 8 equal units and say what one unit is worth.
hints: Eighths mean 8 equal units in the whole.
Before lunch is 3 units and after lunch is 5 units.
items.explanation: 120 divided by 8 is 15, so one unit is 15 km. Dina drove 3 units, which is 45 km, before lunch.

items.prompt: A school sold five sixths of its 72 tickets. Build a part-whole model with 6 equal units and say what one unit is worth.
hints: Sixths mean 6 equal units in the whole.
Sold is 5 units and not sold is 1 unit.
items.explanation: 72 divided by 6 is 12, so one unit is 12 tickets. Sold is 5 units, which is 60 tickets.
